description: Food Price Monitoring and Analysis FPMA is published by FAO. FPMA publishes domestic and international food prices with market analysis and price-anomaly warnings. Its stated coverage is Multiple countries and markets, especially developing countries. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through its website or linked resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. The inspected public resource is free to access. The inspected page does not state a reusable licence. Market and commodity coverage vary; price anomalies do not directly measure household food access. For simulation, it can inform food-supply demand, capacity or disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record data-global-food-twin-food-flows provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
